nba-official.name: NBA official injury reports
nba-official.scope: Daily 5 PM Eastern snapshot, collected after a 30-minute publication allowance. This is not the latest intraday report. Unsubmitted team reports are identified separately.

ncaa-men-scac.name: SCACCHoops conference listings
ncaa-men-scac.scope: Men's conference pages provided by SCACCHoops; not a complete NCAA injury registry. The source supplies no report dates, and listings may be old.

wnba-official.name: WNBA official injury reports
wnba-official.scope: Daily 5 PM Eastern report PDF during the configured May–October collection window. WNBA team mapping is separate from the NBA. Not the latest intraday report.
wnba-official.message: Collection is paused outside the configured May–October window. This is a polling schedule, not a statement about player availability.

ncaa-women-acc.name: ACC women's availability reports
ncaa-women-acc.scope: ACC conference games only. Availability reports do not identify the medical reason for an absence.
ncaa-women-acc.message: The embedded provider returns HTML instead of a readable robots policy. Confirm permitted automated access and validate its feed before enabling.
